reason: Provides a plan review and execution workflow with model selection, reasoning controls, plan approval, automatic execution prompting, and local plan staging.

summaries.zh: 改进计划审查流程，支持选择执行模型与思考强度、批准并启动计划，以及将计划暂存到项目目录。
summaries.en: Improves plan review by letting users choose the execution model and reasoning intensity, approve and start plans, and stage plans in the project directory.

capabilities: Replaces the plan review interface with a modal dialog
Allows selecting an execution model and reasoning intensity
Switches the session model before approving a plan
Approves plans and sends a start-execution message
Writes staged plan Markdown files under the session project directory
